_comment: DEMONSTRATION DATA. Starter facts for pipeline testing only; NOT a substitute for formally approved MEDKids source documents. Must be confirmed by the reviewer before any real use.
source_title: MEDKids Kidneys starter card (demonstration data, unreviewed)
primary_objective: Understand how the kidneys clean the blood
educational_content: The kidneys are two bean-shaped organs. The kidneys clean the blood. The kidneys take waste out of the blood. The kidneys make urine. Drinking water helps the kidneys do their job.
learning_objectives: The kidneys are two bean-shaped organs.
The kidneys take waste out of the blood.
Drinking water helps the kidneys work.
